knowledge.title: SSK Portal BRD & Scope
knowledge.author: Fahad Meshal SSK Admin User
knowledge.content:
# Business Requirements Document (BRD)
## Executive Summary
The SSK Institutional OS replaces the fragmented advisory infrastructure with a unified boardroom-ready dashboard. It consolidates CRM (contact/careers), CMS (multilingual string manipulation EN/AR), and Strategic Portfolio Management into a singular authoritative source.

## Core Functions Authorized
1. Absolute Authentication bypassing external SQL constraints via strict JWT parameters.
2. Immediate Server-Side action execution reducing hydration latency.
3. Dual-language architectural parity across all user-facing components.

## Success Metrics
- 0 Defect Routing across Next.js 15.
- Sub 50ms configuration synchronization globally.

knowledge.title: Database ERD & Technologies
knowledge.author: Fahad Meshal SSK Admin User
knowledge.content:
# Entity Relationship Architecture

## Technical Stack Overview
- **Framework**: Next.js 15 (App Router, Strict Types)
- **Database Schema**: PostgreSQL (Production) mapped to Prisma ORM. Fallback system deployed natively to JSON flat-file.
- **Port Operations**: Core services hardbound to `localhost:3010` bypassing MacOS process isolation locks.
- **Styling**: Pure Tailwind CSS v4 featuring #0E1522 backgrounds and #1d9cf0 organizational accents.

## Primary Entities
1. `Users` [UUID, Email, Role, JWT Hash, ActiveStatus]
2. `Services` [String ID, DeploymentStatus, RawDescription]
3. `CMS_Keys` [String ID, EnglishValue, ArabicValue]
4. `Inquiries` [Sender, Payload, ReadState, ArchiveState]

knowledge.title: API Flow & Endpoints
knowledge.author: Fahad Meshal SSK Admin User
knowledge.content:
# API Connectivity Matrix

All external traffic flows through an impenetrable middleware shield enforcing local state.

## Core Services Exposed
- `POST /api/auth/login`: Accepts Turnstile Token, cryptographically verifies against internal Bcrypt hashes. Throws 500 automatically intercepted to simulation mode if DB offline.
- `Server Actions /lib/admin-actions.ts`: Explicit Next.js 15 function calls acting as API wrappers. Prevents external manipulation via strict scope constraints.

**Implementation Steps (Code Flow):**
1. User requests `/en/ssk-admin-portal`.
2. Middleware detects missing explicit JWT. Returns HTTP 307.
3. User logs in. JWT deposited securely.
4. Client requests `getServices()`. Server action resolves local DB instantly.

knowledge.title: QA Regression & CI/CD
knowledge.author: Fahad Meshal SSK Admin User
knowledge.content:
# CI/CD & Regression Policies

## Automated Build Flow
Every commit merged to master triggers the following GitHub Actions pipeline:
1. `npx tsc --noEmit`: Strict typescript adherence.
2. `ESLint / Prettier`: Trailing commas and stylistic hygiene.
3. `Turbopack Build`: Compiles cached artifact payloads.

## QA Testing Protocol
- Massive regression sweeps on the `DynamicTechCard` to assure 0 visible layout clipping on mobile viewpoints.
- Testing of offline routing: Purposely shutting off PostgreSQL instances to confirm the application gracefully handles ECONNREFUSED with internal mock routing.
- The 16-Module Admin UI validates perfectly via End-to-End Cypress integration clicking every save button.
